study.comparator: acarbose 50 to 100 mg three times daily plus metformin
study.notes: STUDY: prospective open randomised controlled trial (random number table) in 36 adults with obesity (BMI 28 or more, central obesity) and type 2 diabetes uncontrolled on metformin (HbA1c 8 percent or more), exenatide 5 ug twice daily for one month then 10 ug twice daily (dose_mg 0.01 per injection) plus metformin vs acarbose 50 to 100 mg three times daily plus metformin, 3 months (13 weeks entered); 18 randomised per group, 3 and 2 withdrew, 15 and 16 analysed (Table 1 n); tables give baseline and 3 month mean (SD) per group with within group t tests and between group t tests at 3 months (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; the between group p at 3 months is a comparison of final values, recorded in the row notes, not used); first author Jing Zhu (author list on the page: Zhu J, Yang P, Tang X, Yu W, Pan C, Shen M, Zhu D, Cheng J); primary endpoint intra abdominal fat area by CT, the biomarkers here are named secondary endpoints (prespecified TRUE); weight change not tabulated (BMI 31.48 to 30.22 in the exenatide group, 31.13 to 30.94 in the control group), pct_weight_change empty; partly funded by a provincial discipline construction project (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

json.design: open randomised controlled trial, exenatide plus metformin vs acarbose plus metformin, 3 months, 36 randomised, 31 analysed
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); twelve inventory markers from Tables 1 to 6 by the imputed change route
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: HOMA_IR (reported as LN(HOMA-IR) means per group; a natural log scale mean is not converted here)
other_markers: total and subcutaneous abdominal fat area

rob.justification: S: random number table, concealment not described (D1); open trial with titrated comparator (D2 high); 5 of 36 withdrew, completers analysed (D3); CT and laboratory outcomes (D4 low); no registration seen, endpoints named in the methods (D5 some concerns)

doubts: units of the inflammatory markers differ between Table 1 and Table 6 (ng/mL vs pg/mL); the Table 6 units are used and the values kept as printed
HOMA-IR reported on the natural log scale only
